name: Sun
overview: Scripture reveals that God created the sun as a great light to rule the day, setting it in the heavens to give light upon the earth and to separate day from night. From the very beginning, the sun serves not only as a source of physical light but also as a marker for time, seasons, and signs, demonstrating God's sovereign design and order in creation. These truths emphasize God's authority over all creation, including the celestial bodies, highlighting His power and intentionality in establishing the natural world.
